history.summary: Plan for slice 010 completed and committed (7d9f346); task shape is cross-cutting. It has seven phases: P1 ArgoCDDeploy (webhook secret in the hook environment, namespace grant removed), P2 HelmCharts (reconciler-aware orphan audit that never lists an Argo-owned release as an uninstall candidate), P3-P5 KubeCoderDeploy (chart on homelab-shared with stage config and render gate; the seven Build-Main pins; Terraform for the ZFS PV plus the dev-owned webhook), P6 the KubeCoder manifest line, and P7 the diff-preview procedure in the Argo runbook. verification.json has 24 outcome-level criteria mapped 1:1 to R1-R15 and the rulings; the close-out holds three operator outstanding actions and one suggestion for slice 012.

Plan is sound against slice.md and the cited code, but P6's Target ../KubeCoder carries a gate needing python/frontend tool containers this environment lacks, so the loop cannot land it green — an operator decision; plus one advisory on P5's homelab-provider zfs_pools claim.

Applied plan-review r1 rulings F1 and F2 (commit fb1a640 in AnsibleSpecs). F1: the KubeCoder phase is removed, V14 records KubeCoder's manifest line as delivered before the run (KubeCoder 1e523e79, config.yaml:28), V23/V24 keep KubeCoder out of the slice's gates, and close-out A1 is noted. F2: P5 and V10 now require the Terraform to pass var.zfs_pools to the homelab provider block, since the attribute has no environment fallback (provider.go:261). The dry run parses 6 phases (P1-P5, P7).
